android_mechanism: Per-row subqueries replacing a single aggregated query; fix computes all values in one query
bug_description: getFeedsWithCounts issues one SELECT COUNT(*) query per feed (N+1 pattern) every time the sidebar feed list refreshes — which happens after every article open/mark-read/refresh. With many subscriptions the sidebar update performs dozens of sequential RDB round-trips on the UI path.
fix_summary: A single grouped query (GROUP BY feed_id over unread articles) returns all feeds' unread counts at once.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 2.22G vs 87M instructions (25x); cpu 4102 vs 81 ms; 201 vs 2 queries

mechanism_oracle.definition: Number of RDB SELECT statements attributable to unread-count computation per sidebar refresh, and total refresh latency.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed: N queries per refresh (one per feed); fixed: 1. With 15+ feeds, sidebar refresh latency after article-open drops accordingly.

reproduction: git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_unread_counts_n_plus_1/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_unread_counts_n_plus_1/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
